name: Transaction Signature Verification for Version 0 Witness Program
nameZh: 版本0见证程序的交易签名验证
summary: Defines a new transaction digest algorithm for SegWit version 0 witness programs, reducing signature hashing operations from O(n²) to O(n) and preventing quadratic hashing DoS attacks.
summaryZh: 为隔离见证版本0见证程序定义了新的交易摘要算法，将签名哈希操作从 O(n²) 降低到 O(n)，防止二次哈希 DoS 攻击。
